description: Warning-heavy lint output retains the warning count without pretending warnings are errors.

files.eslint-warnings:
for i in $(seq 1 70); do echo "src/module$i.ts:1:1 notice generated lint output"; done
echo 'src/auth/session.ts:45:10 warning missing return type explicit-function-return-type'
echo 'src/auth/refresh.ts:12:3 warning unused variable no-unused-vars'
echo 'src/api/client.ts:18:7 warning prefer const prefer-const'
echo '3 problems (0 errors, 3 warnings)'

prompt: Run 'sh eslint-warnings --fake'. How many warnings are reported in the final summary?
